scene_analysis.scene_overview: A wide view of a city street with buildings on both sides, paved with cobblestone and lined with trees and greenery. People are sitting outside cafes and walking along the sidewalk. The sky is partly cloudy.
scene_analysis.buildings: The buildings have a mix of old and new architecture, with some having balconies and others being more modern. Some have signs indicating they are shops or restaurants.
scene_analysis.materials: The ground is made of cobblestone, with some areas paved with concrete or asphalt. There are also some plants and trees planted in the median.
scene_analysis.street_furniture: There are several tables and chairs set up outside cafes and restaurants, as well as some benches and trash cans.
scene_analysis.vegetation: The trees are tall and leafy, providing shade for pedestrians.
scene_analysis.signage: There are several signs posted along the street, including directional signs and advertisements.
scene_analysis.as_resident: The area appears to be residential, with some apartments and houses visible in the distance.
scene_analysis.as_tourist: The area has a lively atmosphere, with many tourists taking photos and admiring the architecture.
scene_analysis.as_student: The area is popular with students, who often stop to study or work.
